hardware: MacBookAir10,1, Apple M1, 8 CPU cores, 8589934592 bytes RAM
models: Frozen real model copies before compilation; no State shim. The archived baseline/new reader comparison predates unrelated 1.2 model additions.
fixture_parent: Private temporary fixture directory; fixture contents are not checked in
fixture_storage: Local APFS /System/Volumes/Data, physically written repeating deterministic nonzero bytes (not sparse)
bias_control: Each scenario/mode gets an unmeasured prewarm. Five measured repeats per actual scenario/mode, deterministic shuffled method order each repeat (seed 20261106). Fresh process per run. No global cache purge.
metrics: Elapsed monotonic time around the awaited pin call; process CPU delta from getrusage; process-wide peak ru_maxrss in bytes (macOS); serialized progress callback count
old_baseline: Original sequential FileHandle/Data PinEngine source archived before editing; only enum renamed OldPinEngine to coexist in benchmark binary. No autoreleasepool or other performance repairs applied to archived code.
synthetic: New implementation only, matched concurrency1/2/3/4 baseline. Requested usleep(10000) before each read including EOF. Utility-QoS timer coalescing/scheduling means actual delay is not exactly 10ms and cannot be treated as network RTT. Three shuffled-order repeats.
limitations: Warm local filesystem only; not real rclone, NFS/FUSE, OAuth, Google Drive, encryption, cold-disk throughput, or 5TB-scale data.
Short timing cases and normal shared machine activity (including concurrent harness/compiler work) introduce noise; raw ranges retained. Machine not isolated.
Peak RSS is process-wide, not exclusively buffer memory. Allocator/autorelease effects in the unchanged original baseline contribute to its larger peak.
Parallelism is not faster for every warm-local case: new1 beats new2 for small-file fixture; new2/3/4 have higher aggregate CPU for medium files.
This demonstrates cache warming and bounded Swift file-I/O allocation; it cannot prove persistence against rclone eviction or general network speedup.

Cancellation prevents new work and checks between chunks, then joins/cleans up all workers. An already-blocked kernel read cannot safely/reliably be interrupted by cross-thread close; cancellation may await the filesystem response.
source_status: Measured pin implementation snapshot on 6 November 2026, not a final aggregate 1.2 application validation
distribution_method: p95 is a descriptive linear interpolation of sorted values at index (n-1)*0.95; n=5 actual or n=3 synthetic. It is not a reliable population tail estimate.
